cues: Second: the period grows as the square root of the length.
Make the string four times longer, and the period only doubles.
The short pendulum swings twice, for every single swing of the long one.
text: Second: the period grows as the square root of the length. Make the string four times longer, and the period only doubles. Count with me. The short pendulum swings twice, for every single swing of the long one.
